policy: Manual research only overrides dimensions that cannot be safely derived from authoritative catalog/API evidence. Positive manual values and explicit absence/lifecycle states require evidence. IP rights and file access are independent dimensions.

identity.name: Super Yetis
identity.notes: Sunset 3D-avatar project. Contemporary avatar research listed the 3D deliverable as WIP with unknown file format; archived sampled token metadata contains no model references.

short_description.value: Super Yetis is an Ethereum PFP collection of randomized full-body 3D yeti characters built around the planned Yetiverse game.

evidence.note: Archived metadata describes randomized 3D characters and the planned multiplayer Yetiverse.
Official SuperYeti Medium publication links this invite from its JOIN OVER 3.5k SUPERYETIS ON OUR DISCORD callout.
Historical index identifies SuperYeti @super_yeti and its project bio.
Published June 15, 2021 and states the Super Yeti project launches that day at 3:00 PM ET.
OpenSea independently lists launch month as Jun 2021.

storage.note: Archived project metadata says the ERC-721 collection is backed by IPFS file storage. No VRM-file storage mechanism was proven.

vrm_inventory.note: No public shipped VRM inventory is proven. Contemporary 3D-avatar research listed Super Yetis as WIP/Q&A with unknown file format, while the archived sampled token metadata has no model references. This does not claim that a VRM could never have existed; it records that no exhaustive public VRM set can be recovered from the available evidence.

evidence.note: Super Yetis: file format unknown; status WIP, Q/A; rigged 3D avatars were being modeled/tested/optimized.
Archived sampled token records contain empty model_refs arrays.

ip_rights.summary: A contemporaneous 3D-avatar catalog reported commercial rights enabled for Super Yeti holders; primary project license/terms text has not been recovered, so the exact scope remains unverified.

evidence.note: The Super Yetis entry marks Commercial rights with a check.

file_access.note: No shipped public VRM download/access flow is proven in the recovered sources, so holder-gating cannot be inferred either way.

project_status.note: Catalog curator confirmed Super Yetis is a sunset project; secondary-market trading may continue even though project development is sunset.
